Hey, welcome aboard! A few things before we get going.

Training: every working set goes to muscle failure within the listed rep range, top sets and back down sets both. Back down sets are 20-25% lighter than your top set. Rest 3-4 minutes after a top set before the back down set. Do 1-3 warm up sets of no more than 6-8 reps before each exercise, never anywhere near failure. If you beat the total rep goal on a rest pause set, add weight the following week. The goal is to beat the logbook every week: more weight, more reps, or better execution.

Check-ins: every other week for now, on Thursday when you wake up, with everything in by 9am Central. Sundays are my day off, so please don't message me on Sundays.

Macros to start: 2400 kcal / 200P / 250C / 65F on training days. Supplements: creatine 5 g daily.
Use code COACH20 at www.example-supps.com for 20% off. You can reach me on 555-123-4567.

Talk soon,
Coach Dan
